slot.brief: Long, subtle sentence involving tense shift and gerund after preposition where everything is actually correct; the trap is that students wrongly mark a correct part.

stem: Choose the part containing an error; choose No error if the sentence is correct. **(A)** Although the panel had questioned the figures when they were first released, / **(B)** it now accepts the revised estimates, having found no evidence of manipulation / **(C)** after examining the underlying records.

verdicts.working: The sentence is grammatically correct: the opening concessive clause is complete, and “having found” appropriately explains why the panel accepts the estimates.

working:
